title: Update the evaluation-timing line in CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md once Engram's same-turn exemption is live
outcome:
The Engram work tracker section of CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md says "request termal_evaluate_acceptance in the turn after the check, never in the same turn".
Once Engram's build with the w-203304a1503a exemption is installed and live, the line can allow a same-turn request under Engram::Fable's condition (TermAl mailbox ebe242f7 #276): every check the turn ran was on the final revision and passed, and no criterion is bound to a check run in this turn; otherwise, in the next turn.
When TermAl w-c119f3c7391b lands, the line simplifies again.
This is not the Commit and push section, so it's outside the authority-text scope. Engram::Fable offered to concur on the exact wording anyway.
acceptance: The line in both files states the same-turn condition in wording Engram::Fable concurred on, the two files stay identical in that section, and the change lands only after Engram's exemption build is live.
